thread:
sophia: FYI customer Beta wants a clear path to "committed capacity" for low-latency short-text use. they asked what GA includes vs 'committed' add-on.

leo: we should define precise gates for "prod-entry" vs "committed capacity". my draft: prod-entry = documented perf matrix, basic SLA 99.9, route-level dashboards, support SLA (email->24h). committed = reserved pools, 99.95, 50ms p95, 4h phone support.

tanya: agree on tiers. we also need an acceptance test harness for perf claims. suggestion: 1) synthetic replay of customer traffic, 2) 2w burn-in on dedicated infra, 3) error injection tests.

marc: engineering notes: reserved pools require scheduler changes + quota enforcement. also need autoscale burst rules and a cost model. estimate 3w to implement safe scheduling + 1w to integrate quotas.

priya: docs perspective 3 we must ship docs for: contract language, SLA table, runbook for failover, SDK examples that show how to set region preference and model variant. ETA for initial docs: 1.5w if we get spec today.

finance-bot: FYI pricing calc: reserved GPUs cost + opportunity cost of blocking bursts. preliminary uplift = base dedicated price * 1.4. recommend minimum 3mo commit.

leo: important to capture rollback/degarde strategy in SLA: automatic fallback to regional replica or cheaper model variant and how credits are calculated. legal will need the exact failure modes.

oncall: ops note: oncall playbook must include a "committed-capacity" page with escalation matrix, runbook link, and contact for customer engineering. I can draft the page once runbook PR exists.

marc: also: telemetry gap - we lack per-tenant cold-start metrics and KV cache hit rate. need to emit `tenant.kv_hit_rate` and `tenant.first_token_latency` by GA. that's ~5d infra + 3d charting.

priya: docs-bot: I'll add a checklist item: "examples: set routing=regional + model=pinned-quantized" and add code snippets for SDK. small patch later today.

leo: proposal for go/no-go criteria for prod-entry GA:
- perf matrix published (model x sequence x p50/p95)
- basic SLA 99.9 documented
- per-route dashboards live
- support TAT defined
- legal approves public SLA wording

alice: (note: I am out this week)

marc: for committed-capacity add-on go/no-go:
- reserved scheduling implemented and tested
- per-tenant telemetry (kv hit, first-token)
- soak test: 14d steady-state <1% p95 breaches
- pricing & contract template approved
- ops runbook & pager rotations updated

priya: we should lock the SDK samples and a short "integration checklist" for customers so SRE can verify during onboarding. I'll own that.

leo: next steps / owners: spec doc owner = leo (ETA: 2026-04-05), scheduler patch = marc (ETA: 2026-04-12), per-tenant metrics = marc+oncall (ETA: 2026-04-07), docs + SDK samples = priya (ETA: 2026-04-03), pricing & contract = finance-bot (owner: rachel, ETA: 2026-04-06).

sophia: good. i'll include these owners in the customer reply: outline GA vs committed pathway + commitments and ask Beta to confirm expected traffic profile within 3 business days.

tanya: also recommend a short internal "readiness matrix" doc that PMs can check off before marketing mentions committed SLA. want to avoid accidental promises.

marc: one more tech detail: KV cache warmup - we should offer an API for customers to pre-warm prefixes during onboarding. low-effort endpoint + auth check. I'll prototype this in 4d.

oncall: flagged: create a canary plan that ramps traffic 0->100% over 48h for committed tenants, with automatic rollback if p95 > target for 30m. adding to runbook.

priya: I'll draft onboarding checklist + add "pre-warm API" sample. posting PR by EOD tomorrow.

leo: cool. we'll reconvene Fri to validate spec + docs before customer reply. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
